wechat-copywrite-alchemy 1.0.0

- Initial release of the 公众号复刻蒸馏写作技能 skill.
- Supports in-depth analysis of an author's writing style and thought process based on multiple articles.
- Generates a unique writing clone (分身) and style prompt for consistent content creation.
- Allows automatic material collection from WeChat official accounts as well as manual input or file path specification.
- Provides easy-to-use natural language workflow—no commands required.
- API key integration required for use (REDFOX_API_KEY).
